statuses.sent: The email has been successfully checked and put in the queue for sending. At this stage we do not know yet whether it was delivered or not.
statuses.delivered: The email has been successfully accepted by the recipient's mail server. Later this status may change to "opened", "clicked", "unsubscribed", or "spam".
statuses.opened: The email has been delivered and read by the recipient. May still change to "clicked", "unsubscribed", or "spam".
statuses.clicked: The email has been delivered and read, and the recipient has clicked one of the links. May change to "unsubscribed" or "spam".
statuses.unsubscribed: The email has been delivered and read, and the recipient has opted to unsubscribe (via the unsubscribe link or the `List-Unsubscribe` header).
statuses.soft_bounced: A transient error occurred while delivering. UniOne retries for **24 hours** from the first attempt. On success → `delivered`, otherwise → `hard_bounced`.
statuses.hard_bounced: Delivery attempts failed; no further attempts. Common reasons: target address not available, message rejected as spam, mailbox has no free space. Extended info in `delivery_info.delivery_status`; full SMTP response in `delivery_info.destination_response`.
statuses.spam: The message was successfully delivered and **manually marked as spam** by the addressee. Only available for FBL-supporting domains: `msn.com`, `outlook.com`, `hotmail.com`, `live.com`, `ukr.net`, `yahoo.com`, `aol.com`.
statuses.accepted: The message has been accepted, but not sent yet.
statuses.subscribed: Delivered and read; the recipient unsubscribed and then **subscribed again**. Can change to `unsubscribed`.

delivery_status.ok_sent: The message has been sent (intermediate status before delivery or non-delivery).
delivery_status.ok_read: The message has been delivered and opened by the recipient.
delivery_status.ok_link_visited: The message has been delivered and opened; the recipient clicked one of the links.
delivery_status.ok_spam_folder: Delivered and placed into the Spam folder by the receiving server.
delivery_status.ok_fbl: Delivered and manually tagged as Spam by the recipient.
delivery_status.ok_unsubscribed: Delivered, and the addressee canceled the subscription using the unsubscribe link.
delivery_status.err_will_retry: One or more delivery attempts were unsuccessful; the system will retry. **Not final.**
delivery_status.err_user_unknown: Address does not exist (and could never have existed).
delivery_status.err_user_inactive: A previously active address is no longer used; delivery has failed.
delivery_status.err_spam_rejected: The message has been rejected as spam.
delivery_status.err_spam_skipped: Not sent because other messages from the same task were previously rejected by the recipient's server as spam.
delivery_status.err_spam_removed: Not sent because other messages from the same task were previously rejected as spam (same as previous, but at later stages of mailing).
delivery_status.err_unreachable: Address tagged as unreachable due to multiple delivery errors.
delivery_status.skip_dup_unreachable: Sending canceled because the address has been previously tagged as unreachable.
delivery_status.skip_dup_mailbox_full: Sending canceled because recent attempts resulted in a "mailbox full" response.
delivery_status.err_too_large: The receiving server says the message is too large.
delivery_status.err_unsubscribed: The addressee has unsubscribed from your messages.
delivery_status.err_blacklisted: The message was rejected because the sender domain or IP was found on a blacklist.
delivery_status.err_skip_letter: Sending canceled because the target address is temporarily unreachable.
delivery_status.err_domain_inactive: The target domain does not exist or does not accept mail.
delivery_status.err_destination_misconfigured: The target domain does not accept mail due to a solvable issue (e.g. SMTP service temporarily down).
delivery_status.skip_dup_temp_unreachable: Sending canceled because the target address is temporarily unreachable.
delivery_status.err_lost: The email was not sent due to inconsistency of its structure, or lost due to an internal error. The user should re-send the letter.
delivery_status.err_internal: An internal error occurred. The user should re-send the letter.
delivery_status.err_delivery_failed: Delivery failed due to unspecified reasons.

blocking_reasons.unsubscribed: The addressee unsubscribed (link in body / `List-Unsubscribe` header), or was added via `suppression/set`.
blocking_reasons.temporary_unavailable: One or more previous attempts failed; address tagged "temporarily unavailable". Cleared in a few days. Underlying causes (mailbox full, spam block, etc.) are described in the extended statuses table.
blocking_reasons.permanent_unavailable: Address permanently unavailable, verified by multiple sending attempts. Usually in effect ~half a year.
blocking_reasons.complained: The addressee tagged a previous letter as spam, complained in another form, or was added via `suppression/set`.
blocking_reasons.blocked: Address blocked by the system (small number — mostly spam traps or addresses like `support@gmail.com` that don't belong to a person).
blocking_reasons.invalid: The target address is invalid (e.g. the `@` sign is missing).
blocking_reasons.duplicate: The address was included in the same `email/send` call more than once.

validation.unknown: Could not perform validation — the domain's mail server did not respond within the time limit
validation.no_mx_record: No MX record found for the target domain
validation.possible_typo: The address is likely to have a typo (see `did_you_mean`)
validation.global_suppression: The address has been marked unreachable due to multiple previous delivery errors
validation.disposable: A disposable one-time email address (usually valid for only a few minutes)
validation.role: Not likely to belong to an actual person, but rather to a business staff role (e.g. `info@`, `support@`)
validation.abuse: Known to be a source of a large number of complaints, sometimes issued automatically
validation.spamtrap: A spam trap — published openly but never used for actual email; sending here has a huge negative reputation impact
validation.smtp_connection_failed: The domain's SMTP server does not respond; the address may contain a typo

suppression_cause.temporary_unavailable: The address is unavailable; over the next **three days** sending returns an error. Causes include: a previous email rejected by the recipient's server for spam; the recipient's mailbox is full or unused; the recipient's domain does not accept mail; the sending server was rejected due to blacklisting
suppression_cause.permanent_unavailable: The address is permanently unavailable due to **multiple hard bounces**
suppression_cause.complained: The recipient reported spam in previous emails
suppression_cause.blocked: Sending to the email is prohibited by the **administration of UniOne** *(appears in `suppression/get`/`suppression/list`; the docs note "We may add some new causes in the future.")*
